postgresql.notes: Used for local dev and CI; exact patch version resolved at image pull time (18.6 on 2026-10-25, image built 2026-10-21). Moved from 16-alpine by Phase 19a on 2026-10-25. The 18+ official image defaults PGDATA to /var/lib/postgresql/<major>/docker and refuses to start when anything is mounted at the old /var/lib/postgresql/data, so the compose volume is mounted at /var/lib/postgresql. docker-compose.dev.yml's db_client (./go db) also uses postgres:18-alpine as its psql, replacing the unmaintained amd64-only jbergknoff/postgresql-client:latest (psql 12.3, built 2020-08). Other lines on 2026-10-25: 17 (EOL 2029-11-08), 16 (EOL 2028-11-09); 19rc1-alpine is on Docker Hub with community GA planned 2026-11-19 — keep compose at most one major ahead of RDS.

rds.notes: All three environments on 16.13. RDS offers 18.x (minors through 18.6 as of 2026-08) and lists 19 only as a preview-environment beta. Phase 19b (16.13 → 18.x with snapshots, development → staging → production, parameter group family postgres16 → postgres18) is a separate PR in core-iac.
